src_out.description: Defaults to the end of the music or of the video

id.description: Id for the new clip; generated if omitted

index.description: Position in the video track; None = append

AudioItem.description: Music on the audio track, at an absolute timeline time.

duck.description: Lower the music while someone speaks

AudioItem.title: AudioItem

track_id.description: Object track produced by the `lacak` tool

object_ids.description: Objects of the track to blur; None = all

exclude_ids.description: Objects never blurred (e.g. the main subject)

hold.description: Seconds the blur holds across missed detections

speed.description: 0.5 = slow motion, 2 = twice as fast; audio is muted when not 1

crop.description: Empty = centered crop; times are clip-local timeline seconds

transition.description: Transition into this clip from the previous one

CropKey.description: Crop window center at a clip-local time, normalized to the source frame (0..1).
CropKey.title: CropKey

letterbox.description: Cinema bars to this aspect ratio, e.g. 2.39

Follow.description: The tracked object a clip's crop keys follow; the checker verifies it stays in frame.
Follow.title: Follow

Grade.description:
Color adjustments, all 0 = untouched. Ranges are the safe bounds the renderer accepts.

What each field does to pixels is defined once in auteur/grade.py (and ported to the editor).

highlights.description: Brighten (+) or recover (-) the bright end

shadows.description: Lift (+) or deepen (-) the dark end

log.description: Camera log profile to convert to normal contrast before grading

look.description: Preset this grade came from, for display

Grade.title: Grade

object_ids.description: Objects to keep bright; None = all

recorded_at.description: Capture time from the file's metadata (ISO 8601), if any

Overlay.description: A B-roll clip on the second video track, at an absolute timeline time.

layout.description: full covers the frame; the corners are picture-in-picture

Overlay.title: Overlay

last_render.description: Path of the latest render, relative to the project dir

spent.description: Meta Model API spend in USD across all runs

follow.description: Object the keys follow (set by reframe)

letterbox.description: Cinema bars to this ratio (2.39 = scope); null removes

speed.description: 0.5 = slow motion; the clip's source range stays the same

transition.description: Into this clip from the previous one; null removes it

new_clip_id.description: Id for the right half; generated if omitted

text.description: Line breaks (\n) are kept as-is by both the preview and the renderer

look.description: bersih: clean white; tebal: big bold caps; karaoke: spoken word lights up; kotak: spoken word in a color box; pop: words appear as they are spoken

TextWord.description: One spoken word of a subtitle, in timeline seconds, for word-by-word looks.
TextWord.title: TextWord

TrackInfo.description: Index entry for an object track; the boxes live in <project_dir>/tracks/<id>.json.
TrackInfo.title: TrackInfo

Transition.description:
How a clip enters from the previous one. A crossfade overlaps the two clips by `duration`;
dips fade out to a color and back in without overlapping.
Transition.title: Transition

Zoom.description: Slow push in/out over the clip (Ken Burns): scale 1 = the normal crop.
Zoom.title: Zoom
